### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 25  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.666)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:22947)

**Proposed mechanism:** NLRP7 (HGNC:8114) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP7 inflammasome complex assembly and activation (GO:0032652); NLRP7 inflammasome complex assembly and activation (GO:0032652) —DECREASES→ IL-1 beta and IL-18 maturation and release (GO:0032770); IL-1 beta and IL-18 maturation and release (GO:0032770) —LEADS_TO→ Hydatidiform mole (HP:0001364); IL-1 beta and IL-18 maturation and release (GO:0032770) —LEADS_TO→ Oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest (HP:0033745). Loss-of-function mutations in NLRP7 disrupt its role in inflammasome assembly and activation, leading to impaired maturation and release of IL-1 beta and IL-18. This downstream effect impacts embryonic development, manifesting as both hydatidiform mole formation and oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in NLRP7 in individuals with hydatidiform mole, recurrent or oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 25 with a minor allele frequency > 0.01 in gnomAD would falsify the claim that these variants are causative. _(variant: HGNC:8114)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared NLRP7 mechanism could lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting the IL-1 pathway or related downstream effectors for both recurrent hydatidiform mole and infertility due to maturation arrest.
